msgMainDropLabel: Jawo fayilolin sauti don ƙara su
msgMainListEmpty: Babu fayiloli tukuna. Jawo fayilolin sauti zuwa wannan taga.
msgStgAboutDesc: samfuri ne na aikace-aikacen Rust na yaiol.
msgMainNoFfmpeg: Ba a sami injin juyawa (ffmpeg) ba. Sanya shi kusa da app, ko shigar da shi kuma ƙara shi zuwa PATH.
msgDstPatternHint: Danna alama don ƙarawa. Slash yana yin sub-jaka.
msgDstSourceFixed: Wannan shigarwa koyaushe yana rubutawa kusa da fayil ɗin asali kuma yana riƙe da sunansa.
msgPrsRingtoneLimit: An yanke sautin ringin iPhone zuwa daƙiƙa 40, mafi tsawon lokacin da iOS ke karɓa.
lblDstKeepStructure: Ajiye tsarin fayil lokacin canza fayil
msgPrsId3Hint: 2.3 kowane mai kunnawa yana karanta shi kuma shine abin da Mp3tag ke rubutawa ta tsoho. 2.4 shine sabon sigar kuma yana adana rubutu azaman UTF-8. Dukansu suna riƙe filin da aka maimaita azaman ƙima daban-daban.
lblStgNotify: Nuna sanarwa idan an gama canzawa
lblClnKeepTags: Kebantattu: alamomin da za a ajiye
lblClnRemoveTags: Banbance-banbance: alamomin da za a share
msgClnRemoveTagsHint: Suna ɗaya a kowane layi (ko raba shi da ;), kamar yadda editan alamar ku ke nunawa (COMMENT, ENCODERSETTINGS, LYRICS). Ana ba da shawarar sunaye da aka sani yayin da kuke rubutawa; danna ɗaya don amfani da shi. Alamar * tana dacewa da kowane rubutu: REPLAYGAIN_*. Sunaye ba sa kula da girman haruffa.
msgMainProgress: {done} daga cikin {total} fayiloli an sarrafa su
msgMngReorderHint: Ja shigarwa don canza tsari. Ana amfani da tsari iri ɗaya a cikin jerin taga.
lblAdvAlgorithm: Ingancin mai sanyawa (0 mafi kyau, 9 mafi sauri)
lblAdvOpusPhase: Juyar da matakin sitiriyo mai ƙarfi
tipMainParallel: Fayiloli da aka canza a lokaci guda
tipMainDestination: Inda aka rubuta fayilolin da aka canza
tipMainOverwrite: Abin da za a yi idan fayil ɗin fitarwa ya riga ya wanzu
msgFxSilenceEndHint: Ana yanke waƙar inda ta tsaya kuma daidai wannan shirun yana biyo baya, don haka waƙoƙin album su rabu sosai a kowane mai kunnawa.
lblFxSilenceThreshold: Ana ƙidaya a matsayin shiru ƙasa da (dB ƙarƙashin cikakken sikelin)
lblFxSilenceMargin: Ajiye wannan adadin na tsohon ƙarshen (ms)
lblFxTarget: Ƙarar sauti mai niyya (LUFS ƙarƙashin cikakken sikelin: 16 yana nufin -16 LUFS)
msgFxReplayGainHint: Yana rubuta ribar waƙar da kololuwa a matsayin alamun; sautin da kansa baya canzawa. Masu kunnawa kamar MusicBee suna daidaita ƙarar daga gare su.
msgFxTrimSilenceHint: Yana yanke shiru kafin sauti ya fara da kuma bayan ya tsaya. Ba a taɓa shiru a cikin waƙar ba.
lblFxTrimMargin: Ajiye wannan shiru a kowane yanke (ms)
msgFxCutRangeHint: Yana ajiye ɓangaren tsakanin lokutan biyu kawai, wanda aka ƙidaya daga abin da ya rage bayan tasirin da ke sama.
msgFxLimitHint: Yana riƙe mafi yawan waɗannan daƙiƙa, daga farko.
msgFxVolumeHint: Yana saita yadda waƙar take da ƙarfi, ta ɗaya daga cikin hanyoyi huɗu. Mai iyakancewa yana bin duk wani ƙarfi da zai iya yanke.
lblFxUseAlbum: Yi amfani da ribar album (fayil iri ɗaya, alamar album iri ɗaya)
msgFxFadeInHint: Yana ɗaga sauti daga shiru a tsawon wannan lokaci, a farkon abin da aka ajiye.
msgFxFadeOutHint: Yana rage sauti zuwa shiru a tsawon wannan lokaci, a ƙarshen abin da aka ajiye.
msgFxChannelsHint: Yana canza yadda ake amfani da tashoshi biyu: musanya su, kunna ɗaya a bangarorin biyu (tushen mono a bangarorin biyu ma), ko haɗa su zuwa ɗaya.
msgFxRepairHint: Yana cire gajerun dannawa kuma yana sake gina kololuwar da aka yanke. Gyara na gaske: yana ɗaukar lokaci fiye da sauran tasiri.
msgFxLowCutHint: Yana cire sauti ƙasa da mitar: ruri, amo da kuma daidaitaccen canji na tsoffin canja wuri.
msgFxDenoiseHint: Yana rage amo mai tsayayye kamar shush ko fan. Yana iya barin abubuwan da ba a so a kan kiɗa; gwada ɗan rage kaɗan da farko.
lblFxDenoiseFloor: Matakin amo (dB ƙasa da cikakken sikelin)
msgFxDeEsserHint: Yana tausashe sautunan "s" masu tsauri a murya.
msgFxEqualizerHint: Ƙungiyoyi goma, kowanne octave ɗaya: riba a dB ga kowace ƙungiya, daga -12 zuwa +12.
msgFxToneHint: Yana ɗagawa ko rage ƙananan da manyan ƙarshen, a cikin dB.
msgFxDynamicsHint: Mai matsi yana rage abin da ke sama da iyaka; mai daidaita sauti yana daidaita matakin a kan waƙar. Dukansu biyu na iya lalata waƙa idan aka yi amfani da su fiye da kima.
msgFxTempoHint: Yana kunna da sauri ko a hankali tare da kiyaye sautin. Waƙar tana zama gajere ko tsayi.
lblPrsDither: Dither (lokacin da fitarwa ke da 16 bit)
